motif: Guardian knight (the game's red-gold, purple-haired hero) holding the Soul Stone: a tall faceted cyan crystal with a golden star inside, the same stone as the loading key art and the title emblem

source.prompt: Square character illustration for a fantasy tower defense game, with an edge-to-edge background and no frame or border: a close-up bust of a cheerful young guardian knight with spiky dark purple hair, big bright eyes and a confident smile, in ornate crimson red and gold armor, holding up with one gauntleted hand the Soul Stone — a large, tall faceted crystal of luminous cyan and teal shaped like an elongated diamond, glowing from within with a brilliant warm golden star-shaped light — the crystal is as tall as his head and floats just beside his face, lighting his cheek and armor with teal light. Deep midnight-blue background with soft golden sparkles. Centered composition, his face and the crystal fill the middle of the picture, bold readable silhouette, polished painterly premium mobile game art, stylized super-deformed proportions with a large head.
